text:
anne_prod: Heads-up: plan to roll v1.8.2 tonight US->EU->APAC. Change window 22:00-02:00 PT. Canary in us-west-2 first, 5% traffic, then 25, then 100. Need capacity check and pin plan.
sam_engineer: SGTM. I'll kick off preflight 21:30 PT and hold on the canary gate. What are rollback triggers?
anne_prod: Rollback triggers: 3xx/5xx > 1% over 2m OR p95 latency +50% vs baseline OR errors on reranking evals. Also if token cost > +20%.
maria_sre: @anne_prod I'll confirm warm pools. Current free GPUs: US 12/16, EU 6/12, APAC 3/8. EU needs warmup. Recommending scale EU to +4 nodes pre-roll.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight results for v1.8.2
- model build: ok
- container scan: ok
- smoke test: ok
- capacity_estimate: us=+10k rps headroom, eu=+3k, apac=+1.2k
- canary_ready: true
leah_p: Noted. I'll do the pinning steps. Plan: pin us at canary, if canary good then pin eu, then apac. Command I'll run:
`redwoodctl pin --version 1.8.2 --region us --notes "canary pin"`
jay_ops: Question: if EU warmup fails, do we delay APAC? My preference: block APAC until EU at least at 25%.
tom_oncall: Agree. Also set rollback window to 15m post-100% in each region. I'll watch alerts. paging policies ready.
sam_engineer: I'll watch perf dashboards and have a quick eval harness (small prompt set) running against canary.
maria_sre: Started EU warmup: scaling +4 nodes. ETA 6m. APAC warmup pending after EU passes.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started us-west-2 @4201234600, slice=5% traffic, rollout_id=rl-4201
anne_prod: :thumbsup: keep all logs in the thread. If anything noisy, tag #incidents. Remember to mute non-critical alerts for canary.
sam_engineer: Canary smoke: checking latency now... p95 baseline=120ms, current p95=140ms (+16%) — below the +50% trigger. No increase in 5xx.
maria_sre: EU warmup done: EU pool free GPUs 10/12 after add.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary pass (quick checks). Ready to advance to 25% in US @4201234660
anne_prod: Advance to 25% US. Leah please pin at 25%. If green in 10m, move to EU canary 5%.
leah_p: Running pin to 25% US now:
`redwoodctl pin --version 1.8.2 --region us --percent 25`
Done. deploy id: pin-4201
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: US advanced to 25% at 4201234675. Observability note: token cost +3%.
sam_engineer: Monitoring... no error spikes. p95 now 130ms. Staying under triggers.
maria_sre: Starting EU canary 5% @4201234680
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: EU canary started @4201234685, slice=5%
jay_ops: Quick reminder: if EU reports perf regression, fallback plan is immediate pin to v1.8.1 in that region and throttle traffic back to 0%.
anne_prod: If APAC capacity still low after EU, we can gate APAC and schedule follow-up warm pool later. No forced APAC rollout tonight unless explicit green.
tom_oncall: I'll keep a 30m post-EU holdpoint to verify sustained metrics. Page me if any 5xx > 0.8%.
sam_engineer: All quiet so far. Thanks team.
